      "to": "ConfigNakSent"

      "to": "ConfigNakSent"
    },
    {
      "from": "MagicNumberCollision",
      "event": "receive Configure-Request with different Magic-Number",
      "action": "set no collision",
      "to": "ConfigAckReceived"
    },
    {
